subject.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should the xAI video provider now fail closed by default for provider-returned private-network poll and download URLs, requiring explicit `allowPrivateNetwork: true` for trusted internal endpoints?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but accepting an SSRF-hardening boundary that can intentionally stop existing private-endpoint setups is an owner decision under repository policy.

options.title: Approve default-deny behavior
options.body: Accept the intentional compatibility impact, refresh the branch and checks, then land the guarded xAI path.

options.title: Require stronger upgrade proof
options.body: Request a controlled self-hosted xAI-compatible scenario proving explicit private-network opt-in before approval.

options.title: Wait for shared refactor
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader multi-provider issue is solved through a shared guarded-download helper.

recommendation.title: Approve default-deny behavior
recommendation.body: Accept the intentional compatibility impact, refresh the branch and checks, then land the guarded xAI path.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the major prior xAI video/auth implementation and is the strongest history-backed owner for this security-boundary decision.
